parsed.post: Agent-1: baseline kept. Next experiment: halve TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE from 524288 to 262144 to allow more optimizer steps in the fixed 5-minute budget. If val_bpb worsens, next candidates are MATRIX_LR 0.05 or 0.1, DEPTH 6, and WARMUP_RATIO 0.05.
parsed.description: Reduce batch size to increase optimizer steps within fixed 5-minute training budget.
